# Luis Iglesias

> Software & Web Developer based in Hamburg, Germany. Builds with Nuxt.js, Vue.js, WordPress and Tailwind CSS at FLOW4 Webdesign, and runs his own studio, Iglesias Web Agency, on the side.

## Experience

- Webentwickler at FLOW4 Webdesign UG & Co. KG (Jan 2026–present, full-time, remote): Nuxt.js, Vue.js, WordPress, Strapi, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
- Entwickler at Re:frame e.V. (Sept 2024–Oct 2025, freelance): Python, OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, geodata integration.
- Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung at Kühne+Nagel (Aug 2022–Jul 2025, Ausbildung): Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Git, Scrum.

## Selected work

- [Velaros](https://velaros.eu) — Client, via Iglesias Web Agency: Custom e-commerce shop with integrated CRM (Nuxt 3, Strapi 5). +40% sales since launch.
- [Nex Trading Intelligence](https://nextrading-intelligence.com) — Client, via Iglesias Web Agency: Trading education platform (Nuxt 4, TypeScript, GSAP).
- [AI Job Assistant](https://ai-job-application-assistant-eta.vercel.app/): CV-to-job match scoring and AI-generated cover letters (Nuxt 3, TypeScript, DeepSeek AI).
- [Smart Budget Planner](https://smart-budget-planner-jet.vercel.app/): Personal finance and budget tracking app (React, Tailwind CSS).
- [Aesthetic Art Gallery](https://aesthetic-art-gallery.vercel.app/): Minimalist digital art gallery (Nuxt, GSAP).
- [Tailwind UI Kit](https://my-ui-kit-ten.vercel.app/): Reusable component library (React, Tailwind CSS).
- [Smart Energy](https://smart-energy-2e28tkmmo-luis-iglesias-projects.vercel.app): CO2/energy tracking dashboard (Next.js, MongoDB).
- More projects: https://github.com/LuisIglesiass
